title: When do two populations form two clusters?
description: Two simulated populations of 100 people each. The sliders set the Fst between the populations and the number of variants. The plot shows PC1 and PC2. The two populations separate on PC1 only when the Fst is above a threshold that falls as the number of people and variants grows. The mark on the Fst slider shows this threshold.

stats.label: Separation of A and B on PC1 (0 = none, above 3 = clear)
Fst at the phase change, 1 / sqrt(people x variants)

threshold_marker.label: Phase change for this number of variants
